After the check-up, the dentist advised that the tooth wasn't covered. After the check-up, it was determined that the tooth wasn't covered. The dentist gave excellent advice, suggesting I save money first and make a new appointment if I didn't have the budget. So, I used my insurance for teeth cleaning instead.

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมมิสเตอร์เด็นทิสต์ สาขาอ่อนนุช
text:
I used the 30-baht healthcare scheme here.

I chose this clinic because appointments could be scheduled relatively quickly, and the reviews on Google and other platforms were very positive, which helped me decide to use their services.

The dentist examined my teeth as I requested and performed a scaling procedure. However, I felt the treatment was quite quick, and the scaling might not have been as thorough as I expected. Therefore, I didn't notice a significant difference afterward.

Later, I visited another clinic where the dentist conducted a more detailed oral examination, explained the problems, and performed the scaling. They also found several areas with gingivitis and tooth neck issues requiring further treatment.
This made a noticeable difference in the level of care and thoroughness of the treatment.

My father also received treatment here, and the treatment didn't take long. However, at the other clinic, the dentist provided more detailed fillings and overall care, resulting in a significantly different level of service.

This review is based solely on my and my family's personal experience. Individual experiences may vary. Hopefully, this information will assist other patients in making informed decisions and contribute to future service quality improvement.
